in_hebrew.name: Yuri
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yuri הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek 'Adiaurios' meaning 'not helper of gods'. In Christianity, it is believed to be derived from the name 'Jeremiah' meaning 'exalted by God'.

in_greek.name: Yuri

in_greek.long_meaning: Yuri είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek 'Adiaurios' meaning 'not helper of gods'. In Christianity, it is believed to be derived from the name 'Jeremiah' meaning 'exalted by God'.
